The key finding is in the controller logs:

```
E0517 02:03:12.882410       7 store.go:950] annotation group ConfigurationSnippet contains risky annotation based on ingress configuration
W0517 02:03:12.882455       7 store.go:951] skipping annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet on ingress legacy/legacy-portal: Snippet directives are disabled by the Ingress administrator (allow-snippet-annotations=false)
```

This is the root cause. The `legacy-portal` Ingress uses a `configuration-snippet` annotation (likely containing the regex-based redirect using `rewrite` or `return` directives), but after the upgrade, `allow-snippet-annotations` is set to `false` by default. 

This matches a known security hardening change in ingress-nginx v1.2.1+, where snippet annotations got disabled by default due to past CVEs. I want to confirm this by checking the official docs on the allow-snippet-annotations setting.
